title: lem-sc-cartesian-chart-exchange-naturality
statement: theorem cartesianChartCohomologyLift_exchange {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] (D : I ⥤ Over S) (c : Cone D) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) (i : I) (V : (D.obj i).left.Etale) (U : c.pt.left.Etale) (r : U.left ⟶ V.left) (hr : IsPullback r U.hom V.hom (c.π.app i).left) (j : Over i) (x : restrictedOverCohomology (pullback.snd f (D.obj i).hom) (((pullback.fst f (D.obj i).hom)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F) (q : ℤ) ((cartesianChartDiagram f D i).obj j) V) : cartesianChartCohomologyLift f D c F q i V U r hr j x ≫ (shiftFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map (cartesianDerivedImageMap f (D.obj j.left).hom c.pt.hom (c.π.app j.left).left (Over.w (c.π.app j.left)).symm ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)) = (cartesianChartCohomologyIso f (D.obj i).hom (c.π.app i).left c.pt.hom (Over.w (c.π.app i)).symm F q V U r hr).hom (restrictedOverCohomologyMap (pullback.snd f (D.obj i).hom) (((pullback.fst f (D.obj i).hom)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F) (q : ℤ) ((cartesianChartCone f D c i).π.app j) V x)

proof.text: Apply the naturality theorem for raw restricted cohomology comparison to the cone leg and its coefficient map; expand the canonical raw transport and chart-class pullback maps. Pullback uniqueness and inverse-image composition identify the source and coefficient maps. Take derived adjoints and use the defining mate equation for cartesianDerivedImageMap, then cancel the adjunction unit/counit by the triangle identities. The remaining factors are exactly the restrictedOverCohomologyMap and the canonical apex cohomology isomorphism.
